question: What is the meaning of ability to utilize natural light and related properties in relation to daylighting and illumination?
data_point: ability to utilize natural light and related properties
description: The ability to utilize natural light and related properties in relation to daylighting and illumination refers to the design and construction of buildings that maximize the use of natural light from the sun. This approach can reduce the need for artificial lighting, which in turn can lower energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. Additionally, natural light has been shown to have positive effects on occupant well-being, productivity, and health. In sustainable construction, daylighting and illumination are considered essential elements in reducing the environmental impact of buildings while improving the quality of life for occupants.
